shaheenSafi.name: Shaheen Safi
shaheenSafi.reg: Safi International Capital LTD • UK Reg: 17063286
shaheenSafi.bio: Director, Founder & Lead Fintech Systems Architect of the Safi Global Ecosystem.
shaheenSafi.manifestoQuote: "We did not establish Safi Academy and SafiPay merely to participate in the digital economy—we founded them to build an unassailable financial and educational bridge connecting Afghan youth and global scholars directly with European and American enterprise markets."
shaheenSafi.contactDesc: For strategic corporate partnerships, institutional investments, or international keynotes:
shaheenSafi.manifestoP1: My professional trajectory commenced in the high-stakes, volatile environment of international financial markets. Operating as a full-time trader across the Forex markets and foreign currency matrices from 2016 through late 2024, I developed a deep, visceral understanding of global liquidity flows, order-book dynamics, and institutional risk mitigation.
shaheenSafi.manifestoP2: In December 2024, upon earning the prestigious International Technical Analysis Certification from IFTA (International Federation of Technical Analysts), I recognized that true financial sovereignty cannot be achieved through trading alone—it requires architecting the underlying digital conduits and enterprise software that process global transactions.
shaheenSafi.manifestoP3: Holding a Bachelor of Computer Science degree from Istanbul Technical University (ITU), I integrate rigorous computational engineering with corporate vision. As Founder and Group CEO of Safi International Capital LTD, I lead the technical architecture and strategic trajectory of our key platforms: SafiPay Digital Banking, Safi TopUp Global, SafiPro International Apparel, and Safi Academy.
